snapshot.body.text:
Vital Proteins minute fudge brownie to satisfy your sweet craving!!
 
Ingredients:
2 tbsp plain flour (25g)
2 scoops @vitalproteins.anz chocolate collagen peptides (17g)
1 tbsp stevia or monk fruit sweetener
4 tbsp milk (60ml)
1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp melted coconut oil or butter
1 square chocolate or 1 tsp your fave spread
 
Method:
1. Mix all the ingredients together (except chocolate) in a heat proof ramekin.
2. Press the chocolate/spread into the centre of the batter.
3. Bake for 12-15 minutes at 180C or microwave for ~90 seconds.
